description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier skilled nursing and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment for both residents and staff.In this pivotal role, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and operational efficiency. We offer a competitive salary range of $115,000 to $145,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment to excellence. Join a team dedicated to making a significant impact on the lives of those we serve.
requirements: Active and unencumbered Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in the state of Maryland.
Proven leadership experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Comprehensive knowledge of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage financial, operational, and clinical outcomes effectively.
Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 annually, based on experience.
